items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] He still lives down on North Park. ... [INTERVIEWEE] His real name was Phillips.

ctx.x: He still lives down on North Park.
I know Burgundy now. Burgundy, I think. No, I don't think I knew him. He played clarinet? He played clarinet.
